concerns.text: The plan fits a Generalized Linear Mixed‑Effects Model with a Gaussian link for the Utility metric (see Phase 4 description: “Utility → Gaussian link”). However, Utility is defined per‑episode as a binary success/failure (ground_truth_success), i.e., a Bernoulli outcome. Modeling a binary outcome with a Gaussian link violates GLM assumptions and can lead to biased estimates and invalid inference. The appropriate link would be logistic (or binomial) for binary data, or the analysis should aggregate to proportions and use a beta regression if modeling continuous rates.
